title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: You can Uber around Lima for sightseeing. The neighbourhood of Mira Flores, where we stayed, is walkable too.

To get from Lima to Machu Picchu, you must take planes, trains, and automobiles. Lima to Cusco is a 1.5 hours flight. From Cusco, you can hail a cab to Ollantaytambo, which takes about 1.5 hours (longer if your driver insists on stopping over at tourist traps).
And finally, there’s the vista dome train (1.5 hours long again) from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes, with breathtaking panoramic views of the Andes.
